title: Evidence Collection Log — draft 0.1.0

seq.description: Monotonic per-log sequence, allocated by the log writer (codex rollout form). In-band — makes coverage checking a pure density function. Integer LITERAL only, enforced by the checker rules on both oracle sides ([LEDGER.SEQ_FLOAT_SYNTAX] / [EVIDLOG.SEQ_FLOAT_SYNTAX]) — JSON Schema cannot express this (pattern matches strings only, and its integer type accepts 1.0 by value), so the literal-domain rule lives in code, keyed neutrally (user ruling 2026-11-02: this package does no float math — machine counter domain).

tool.description: The authorized tool channel invoked (e.g. bank-statement.fetch).

selector.description: What was queried within the tool's domain.

caller.description: Who initiated the call (an S2 investigation step id).

result_ref.description: Where the fetched evidence lives (a sealed-store address).

$comment: Known contract gaps driving 0.2.0: (1) networknt 2.x/3.x API break — Java consumer pinned to 2.0.0; (2) pattern-match mode divergence (trailing-newline digest accepted by Py/Go, rejected by networknt) — corpus has no pin; (3) odd-twin folded-value semantics — retired with the v1 charter (R16), now pinned by invalid/seq-odd-float-twin + EVIDLOG.SEQ_FLOAT_SYNTAX; (4) format-doc count staleness — fixed by E1 manifest. (5) KNOWN-DEFERRED (R12 B-F3, 2026-11-02): the two substring pins "at" (evidlog/bad-timestamp) and "not" (replay/match-with-at) are near-vacuous wide substrings — the Go schema-error aggregation emits no field path, so no guard-specific substring exists on both engines; fix rides the schemalib error-detail change, tracked here until then. Gap registry lives in this $comment and docs/conformance-fixture-format.md (in-repo); the GEPA exploration campaign runs in a separate worktree outside this repo.
